resolution.note: selectRequiredCheck prefers the plain Check; test/ci/target-checks.test.ts regression fails on base and passes after; npm run fast PASS

title: ship gate treats the self-test's intentional expected-red check as a failed gate
body: krn pr ship refuses PR #1512 (head 51d8970) because its gate counts the check run 'expected-red / Check' from .github/workflows/project-ci-selftest.yml as a failure. That job is red by design; 'Self-test verdict' and the required aggregate 'Check' passed. Every PR that triggers the self-test is blocked.

Outcome: krn pr ship on a head whose required Check passed and whose only red run is the self-test's expected-red job reaches the merge step (exit 0); a new regression test that fails on the base passes.
Proof: regression test under test/ci plus a real ship of PR #1512.
